name: ai-impact-tracker
description: Measure the environmental footprint of your AI usage from the session transcripts already on your machine - exact token counts, not estimates - and see it in a self-contained dashboard led by the one number that matters: what share of your whole yearly footprint is actually AI. Project drill-down, a usage grade, sourced real-world comparisons, a mitigation checklist, and a sanitised build for sharing that carries no project names.
